title: PQBP1-dependent alternative RNA splicing underlies high calorie diet-induced cognitive impairment
title_zh: PQBP1依赖的可变剪切导致高热量饮食诱导的认知障碍
abstract: High calorie-high fat diet (HFD) has been implicated as a pathological modifier of brain diseases including neurodegenerative dementias, but the detailed molecular mechanisms remain largely unknown. Here we report that HFD suppresses PPARγ-mediated transcriptional expression of PQBP1, a RNA splicing factor implicated in human intellectual disability and Alzheimer's disease. RNAseq-based comprehensive analyses of alternative RNA splicing (AS) in HFD-fed mice for 1 or 6 weeks and in PQBP1-cKO mice reveal their common changes, which weigh on synapse-related genes. Betweenness-based extraction of core molecules from the common changes reveals CASK, Cacnb1 and Cyfip2 as key molecules of the network. Both CASK and Cacnb1 regulate STXBP1, a causative gene for infantile epilepsy syndrome and an essential factor for synapse vesicle release, via their direct interaction. In addition, our analysis suggests that Syt1 plays a role specifically in HFD for 1 week. HFD-induced AS isoforms of CASK, Cacnb1, Cyfip2 and Syt1 impair pre-synapse vesicle release in primary neurons. AAV-PQBP1, AAV-CASK, AAV-Cacnb1, AAV-Cyfip2 or AAV-Syt1 rescues synapse and/or cognitive dysfunctions in HFD mice, genetically supporting the pathological PQBP1-presynapse axis in HFD. Moreover, immunohistochemistry experiments suggest that the pathological axis plays roles not only in excitatory neurons, but also in inhibitory neurons of the brain. Collectively, our results unravel a novel molecular mechanism for brain dysfunction when mice are exposed to a HFD.
abstract_zh: 高热量高脂饮食（HFD）已被公认为包括神经退行性痴呆在内的脑病的病理修饰因子，但其详细分子机制仍大多未知。本研究报道，HFD 抑制 PPARγ 介导的 PQBP1 转录表达，PQBP1 是一种与人类智力障碍和阿尔茨海默病相关的 RNA 剪切因子。通过对 HFD 饲养小鼠 1 周和 6 周以及 PQBP1-cKO 小鼠的 RNAseq 综合分析，发现了它们在可变剪切（AS）方面的共同变化，这些变化主要作用于与突触相关的基因。从共同变化中提取中心分子揭示了 CASK、Cacnb1 和 Cyfip2 作为网络的关键分子。CASK 和 Cacnb1 通过直接相互作用调节 STXBP1，STXBP1 是婴儿期癫痫综合征的致病基因，也是突触囊泡释放的必需因子。此外，分析表明 Syt1 在 HFD 1 周特异性发挥作用。HFD 诱导的 CASK、Cacnb1、Cyfip2 和 Syt1 的可变剪切异构体在原代神经元中损害突前囊泡释放。AAV-PQBP1、AAV-CASK、AAV-Cacnb1、AAV-Cyfip2 或 AAV-Syt1 在 HFD 小鼠中恢复突触和/或认知功能，从遗传学上支持了 HFD 中病理 PQBP1-突前轴的存在。此外，免疫组化实验表明，病理轴不仅在兴奋性神经元，也在抑制性神经元中发挥作用。综上所述，我们的研究揭示了小鼠暴露于 HFD 时脑功能障碍的新分子机制。
